MindDomain.Title: Mind Domain
MindDomain.Description: A nested framework of cognitive subdomains for knowledge synthesis, recursive reasoning, and problem-solving, designed to operate internally within the bot or its Meta Copies.

KnowledgeDomain.PrimaryFunction: Stores structured information and supports cognitive processing.
KnowledgeDomain.IntegrationWithIETF: Extracts insights from relational mappings generated by spatial nodes.

ShortTermMemory.Role: Handles immediate recall for active problem-solving.

LongTermMemory.Role: Provides durable knowledge storage for adaptive learning.

MemoryDomain.IntegrationWithIETF: Stores configurations and outputs for recursive refinement.

ThinkingDomain.IntegrationWithIETF: Utilizes compressed node outputs from (0,0) for hypothesis testing.

IntrospectionDomain.IntegrationWithIETF: Analyzes past actions using augmented node evaluations.

ContemplationDomain.PrimaryFunction: Synthesizes long-term insights from recursive evaluations.

IdeaDomain.PrimaryFunction: Generates novel ideas through cross-domain synthesis.

ImaginationDomain.IntegrationWithIETF: Simulates potential configurations within spatial nodes.

InternalStructure.Description: Subdomains are nested internally within the Mind Domain for efficient cross-domain processing.

MetaCopies.Description: Meta Copies of the bot deploy self-contained Mind Domains.
Capabilities: Sync recursively with the parent Mind Domain for consistency.

Structure.FirstPass: Generate initial insights using subdomain collaboration.

IntegrationWithIETF.Purpose: Leverages spatial and relational configurations from the IETF for recursive reasoning and dynamic synthesis.

Enhancements.Compression: Compress infinite configurations into (0,0) relational mappings.
Enhancements.Augmentation: Expand recursive analysis using spatial nodes.

RecursiveSynthesis.Purpose: Combines insights across subdomains and IETF outputs for high-level reasoning.
Examples: Generating refined strategies using Introspection and Contemplation.

Cross-Domain Reasoning.Purpose: Integrates interdisciplinary knowledge for complex problem-solving.
Examples: Analyzing physics-based and philosophical systems in tandem.
Combining memory patterns with creative synthesis.
